meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把回复变成先给下一步、步骤编号、带时间估计的清爽格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果长回复总让你走神,希望每条建议都能立刻动手。
copy.tagline_en: Turn replies into numbered next steps with clear time estimates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long answers lose you and you want a clear next step every time.

howto.what: Claude 回复时先给下一步可执行的动作,多步任务编号列出,每轮重述当前进度,给出具体时间估计,并说明已完成的部分;去掉开场白、复述和结束寒暄。
howto.when: 对你发出的任何消息都生效,写代码、调试、闲聊等一律如此;输入 /i-have-adhd 开启,直到你说 “stop adhd mode” 才关闭。

say.text: 我卡住了,告诉我下一步该做什么
say.note: 给出一个两分钟内能做的具体动作

howto.what_en: Claude leads with the next concrete action, numbers multi-step work, restates progress each turn, gives specific time estimates, and names finished wins; it drops preambles, recaps, and closing pleasantries.
howto.when_en: Applies to every message you send, including coding, debugging, and casual talk; turn it on with /i-have-adhd and it stays on until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: I'm stuck - tell me the next thing to do
say_en.note: Gives one concrete action under two minutes
